regimens.dose_text: For patients > 30 kg: Start with 10 mg/day (5 mg twice daily). At Day 7, advance to 20 mg/day (10 mg twice daily). At Day 14, advance to recommended target maintenance dose of 40 mg/day (20 mg twice daily). Doses > 5 mg/day should be administered in 2 divided doses.

refs.quote: mild and moderate renal impairment. There is no experience with ONFI in patients with severe renal impairment or end stage renal disease (ESRD).

hepatic.value: Mild to moderate hepatic impairment: Start with 5 mg/day (<= 30 kg) or 10 mg/day (> 30 kg) and titrate slowly. Severe hepatic impairment: No data available.

refs.quote: For patients with mild to moderate hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh score 5-9), the starting dose should be 5 mg/day in both weight groups.
